user_query: I want to organize a surprise party for my family. Fetch me some funny quotes from the 'funny' category using the 'Messages' tool to include in the party invitations. Also, retrieve the number of sent reply messages for a specific date using the LINE Messaging API. Additionally, check if there are any webhooks associated with my SMSAPI.com account.

TaskList.description: Fetch funny quotes from the 'funny' category using the 'Messages' tool for the party invitations.
Retrieve the number of sent reply messages for a specific date using the LINE Messaging API.
Check for any webhooks associated with the user's SMSAPI.com account.
